highlights_headline: Upcoming changes add experimental image comparison tools and correct runtime uniforms, texture-edge sampling and Windows image decoding.
highlights_body: The new SkiaSharp.Testing package provides configurable image acceptance policies and visual difference diagnostics. Linux x86 native assets are no longer packaged.

breaking.title: Move off Linux x86 native assets
breaking.body: Linux x86 native assets are no longer built or included in NuGet packages. Applications using those assets must move to a supported architecture, such as Linux x64 or ARM64.

bullets.detail: SkiaSharp.Testing compares SKImage, SKBitmap and SKPixmap inputs with channel tolerances, masks, mismatch budgets and error metrics, and creates five styles of difference images. Opt in to experimental diagnostic SKIA4001 with NoWarn or a pragma; dispose returned difference images as caller-owned resources.

Fixes process crashes when libjpeg or libpng recovers from decoding errors in clang-built Windows x64 natives. This includes malformed JPEGs passed to SKCodec.Create and PDF generation with lazily decoded non-JPEG images. Windows ARM64, x86 and MSVC builds are unchanged.

bullets.lead: Keep filtered samples inside texture subsets
bullets.detail: Ganesh linear filtering clamps inward at texture-subset edges to avoid sampling undefined exterior texels. Texture-edge pixels may change; CPU and Graphite rendering are unaffected.

Tizen now applies its CPU blur setting to Skia itself, selecting the existing ThreeBoxApprox/Tent path instead of the shader-based Gaussian candidate. Blur pixels and performance may differ; Tizen rendering and performance were not measured in the supporting change.

New SKRuntimeEffectUniforms buffers start at zero instead of containing leftover memory. Reset clears the existing buffer in place, restoring the documented zero values without allocating a replacement native buffer or managed wrapper.

contributor_summaries.taublast: Corrected runtime uniform initialization and reset behavior, and disposed uniform snapshots in tests.
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Restored the Uno Gallery and Uno views projects to the Windows sample solution.
contributor_summaries.SimonCropp: Fixed Windows x64 crashes during JPEG and PNG decoder error recovery.
